charges.extraMaximum: promotion-selected Dynamics times_2 (0/1), consumed only against ELITE/BOSS
charges.clock: one current attack interval while no eligible target; pause on control, reset on target entry/mode changes
charges.modeTransfer: one shared ordinary/extra pool retained across S1/S3 entry, expiration and manual cancellation; bounded policy, native ChargeAttackGroup implementation unavailable
charges.release: one main plus every ordinary charge and elite-eligible extra, consumed only after valid projectile emission; retained release mode coefficients and projectile-attached Appoggiatura survive owner withdrawal

s1.coefficient: selected attack@atk_scale applied to ordinary and stored output; stored output also multiplies Dynamics
s1.clips: literal Skill_1_Begin/Loop/Charge/End, both exact native facings

s2.cast: retained startup INPUT tiles, original Skill_2 .367 event, full one-second clip with disarm/no-SP, scaled by uncapped ASPD
s2.selection: ground-enemy tile then taunt, nearest other ground enemy then seeded random/key tie; bounded interpretation of filterType7
s2.consumption: successful remnant count minus one, elite extra consumed first, unused ordinary storage retained; no replacement for input tile invalidation
s2.remnant: original single Spine, fixed RIGHT, device, no block/slots/ordinary attack; placement-snapshot owner ATK including atkScaleMul (bounded inheritance sample)
s2.trigger: one-second Start entrance then current ground-only radius1.350000023841858, retained INPUT set, explicit .9300000071525574 fuse rather than .433 Spine attack event
s2.effect: native DragTowardSource mapped to existing reviewed pull engine then selected Arts atk_scale on each still-selectable retained ground victim; one attack ID
s2.lifetime: 30 seconds from deployment; previous cast remnants persist; owner withdrawal/death removes remnants and cancels unborn damage

s3.target: native mask6 => ELITE/BOSS only, both motions; normal enemies do not prevent storage
s3.scaling: ATK/ASPD from every selected rank; stored Dynamics scale multiplied by talent_scale_multiplier; main coefficient1
s3.cancel: existing native manualCancel UI command returns to base targeting and resets attack timer while preserving charge counts

appoggiatura.selection: current enemy centres within selected radius1.1, excluding target/device/disappeared/target-free; sleep/flying enemies count
appoggiatura.damage: one separate Arts NORMAL applyWayNONE addition per emitted main/stored projectile, using selected promotion/potential talent; addition precedes primary output as bounded dispatch ordering

verificationLimits: Compiled ChargeAttackGroup/ExChargeAttack/ChargeableAttack implementations are unavailable. Shared cross-mode storage, first-charge phase, fractional timer reset and S1 stored-output coefficient context are tested local policies rather than certified native FSM laws.

Native token base ATK100 is not a recovered owner-inheritance primitive. The adapter snapshots selected current owner ATK and atkScaleMul at successful placement; later owner changes do not propagate to existing remnants.
Native tile filterType7 is retained, but its executable ordering is unavailable. Enemy-tile/taunt/distance/random ordering and successful-placement charge consumption are bounded local mappings.

The remnant waits for its original one-second Start even though hidden Flashback permits casting during Born. Native Born-to-selector dispatch and lifetime phase are not certified. The original explicit .93 delay is retained with 30Hz scheduler quantization.

Appoggiatura centre counting and add-on-before-primary ordering, release-time mode coefficients versus in-flight mode changes, damage-missability/control dispatch and pull-before-damage are not certified against client frames.

Original chibis and literal clips are delivered; bolt, charge orb and explosion particles/audio are not. Native projectile origins/mounts, random S3 A/B/C animation selection, modules, other stage/enemy abilities remain unfinished.
